Subject: Draft acceptance criteria for POC + proposed close sprint

Asha — attaching a lightweight MAP and a first-pass acceptance canvas for the ClearPath POC. The goal here is to make the final decision deterministic: what tests pass, who signs, and the procurement checkpoint.

High-level ask: please confirm the three success signals below and the target go/no-go date of 2026-03-12 so we can lock project resources.

Key success signals (proposed):
- Accuracy: 95% match to human-annotated labels on the 1,000-case test set (see sheet: test-definitions).
- Latency: 95th percentile inference under 220ms for 512-token requests in our dedicated pool.
- Business impact: evidence of 10% reduction in triage manual steps in a 2-week pilot window.

Exit gates we propose: all three success signals met OR agreement to a negotiated mitigation plan + decision by your evaluation committee.

Attachments: clearpath_map_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), acceptance_test_samples.md (example test cases).

If these look right, Monica will own the test execution plan and Priyom will push the SOW draft to procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

2) Procurement constraint: our legal prefers the SOW to list an escrow clause and a two-week termination notice post-pilot (can you share a SOW draft we can review?).
3) Timeline: the evaluation committee meets on 2026-03-11 — can we target the internal sign-off by EOD 2026-03-10 so it reaches committee in time?

Hi team — I've sketched out the acceptance test plan to cover the requested checks. Key additions:

- Redaction recall test: 400-case redaction slice with labeled ground truth. Pass = recall >= 88%. Test will be run twice (initial + post-tuning) to validate stability.
- Smoke perf test: synthetic burst of 100 concurrent requests; 95th p95 < 220ms as Karthik suggested.
- End-to-end UX spot-check: 50 hand-labeled user flows to validate business impact signal (triage steps saved).

Owner matrix (quick):
- Redwood: run inference tests, provide logs & token-level latency breakdown (Monica).
- ClearPath: provide labeled redaction set + access to 2 triage users for UX checks (Asha).
- Procurement/legal: review SOW (Priyom -> will circulate SOW-draft-v2.pdf).

I've attached a short test-case catalog (acceptance_test_samples.md) with input examples and pass/fail criteria. I'll schedule the smoke/perf runs for 2026-03-08 and the main test window 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-11.

Questions for Asha: can you confirm who will own the labeled redaction set and whether we can get it by 2026-03-05 EOD? If not, we should move the main window back one business day.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
